snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 071 - The Renai Simulation 2 - Fureai (2001)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Renai Simulation 2: Fureai is an Adventure game, developed by S-Neo and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2001.
